mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies today with a temperature of 72 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. Under the new moon tonight, you can also spot the International Space Station starting at 8:21 PM. It will be visible for 6 minutes, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the northeast over the Madison area near Home Depot, climbing about halfway up the sky.

In city news, authorities reported that on September 10, officers were dispatched to Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress where a suspect was taken into custody with a firearm. Additionally, the city has posted notices for the upcoming November general election and continues to provide regular engineering updates to the City Council.

There is plenty happening around town. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, Verona hosts the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 14, followed by trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Macs early next week.

On September 10, Verona police responded to a residence in the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way regarding a burglary. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody with a handgun and will face charges including burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Cashew. The store is closed right now but will open today at 10:00 AM to satisfy your craving.
